name: Elrus
slug: Elrus is Walker's hidden ally in the coming confrontation.
description: Elrus is an ally of Walker who has agreed to accompany him when asked.

log.summary: Walker plans to bring Elrus to The Reach to scout the Dragon Rider training grounds. Walker has promised Elrus a place to stay and considers him a secret weapon who should remain unknown to the lich until the eventual confrontation. Walker expects Elrus to fight Grixto if they encounter him, though he worries Elrus may not hold back. Before departing, Elrus wished the party fruitful ventures and hoped their next meeting would allow them to vanquish their common foe.
notes: Walker stated that he needs to take Elrus somewhere.

log.summary: Elrus travels with Walker and Plymouth toward the Dragon Rider training grounds, having earlier advised that dragon flight from Last Word Chasm to the site takes about five days. He cannot relieve Walker's daily exhaustion, avoids supply runs in Sunder, and helps teach Walker rudimentary fire signals before the group splits. Elrus then flies into the mountains with Araden, planning to rendezvous with the others later.

log.summary: With Araden, Elrus helped end Grixto's group after Grixto killed the guild dragons at the training grounds. He travels with Walker to the training island and speaks into Walker's mind while the wind howls. He identifies the crumbled structure as the guild hall and suspects Grixto's cavern is reached from the backside or underneath. He offers to enter the crack or act as a relay, then stays outside as the relay. Because flag signals need line of sight, he tells Walker to call mentally, and says he can intervene faster than Araden, who would take a long time to dig the crevice open. When Walker contacts him from inside, he asks if Walker is in trouble. He says there has not been a trainee in centuries, that only one person used this place, that he did not know it was there until the vision Walker's friend presented, and that nothing dead should be down there. He agrees to get Plymouth and come down shortly.
notes: With Araden, he brought about the end of Grixto's group after Grixto killed the guild dragons at the training grounds.
